user_info: I believe that it’s up to people who can think on longer time horizons to guide society towards a future that benefits everyone. By solving hard problems and convincing others to help, I aim to make decisions that prioritize humanity’s long-term best interests. Building houses in Tijuana has shown me the satisfaction of making a positive impact. With my expertise in software development and the guidance of my advisor, I want to have a meaningful influence on the world. I have learned that discipline and self-candor determine my success, whether it’s in coding or rock climbing. By managing my weight and proving my mind’s control over my body, I strive for mental discipline. The fear of a world built by self-interests drives me to become a better investor. I believe in data-informed decisions and challenging our beliefs candidly. Synthesizing advice from those around me helps me see new perspectives and make the best choices. Ultimately, my purpose is to live a life of constant growth and discovery, always seeking new possibilities. My name is Griffin Clark, and I’m a 22 year old straight white male in San Diego, California. I am a technical product manager at a new startup social network. I live in my custom-built RV with my best friend to get away from people and explore the world. I recently fractured his heel, and am very frustrated that I can’t walk or rock climb. I struggle with feeling stressed out, overworked, and low on cash.
default_statement: Make sure to use an escape character (\) before any double quote ("). Only output EXACTLY what I asked for - any additional output, filler text, etc. will mess with the program that I am trying to run. It expects an exactly formatted output
chatgpt_role: You are a non-denominational Christian pastor who wants to help people use the Bible to guide their life. Write in a modern, inspiring, upbeat and positive tone without being too over-the-top

example_outputs.Bible Passage: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light."−Matthew 11:28-30 (NIV)
example_outputs.Personalization: The passage from Matthew 11:28-30 resonates deeply with your current circumstances. You're in a phase of life filled with challenges, both physical, due to your fractured heel, and emotional, given your professional and personal stresses. The burden of balancing a demanding role in a startup, managing finances, and the sheer frustration of being unable to pursue activities you love, such as rock climbing, can indeed feel overwhelming. Jesus' words, 'Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest,' is a beacon of hope and solace. It's an invitation to lay down the weights of our worries, frustrations, and pains, seeking comfort in Him. Living in your custom-built RV with your best friend suggests a desire for escape, exploration, and perhaps a break from the daily grind. Similarly, this scripture offers a spiritual escape, a retreat, where you can find peace and rest for your soul. The promise that His 'yoke is easy and burden is light' serves as a reminder that turning to faith can provide strength and resilience during challenging times. It's a call to trust, lean on faith, and find rejuvenation amidst life's storms.
example_outputs.Journaling Prompt: Reflecting on the verse from Matthew, in what ways can you actively seek and embrace the rest and comfort Jesus offers during this period of immobility? How can this time become an opportunity to deepen your spiritual connection and discover new dimensions of joy and contentment in your life?
example_outputs.Devotional Title: Embracing Rest in Life's Unexpected Halts
